LanguageData.TM_GrimoireClassicRules: Classic progression: learn and improve abilities under the existing class rules.
LanguageData.TM_GrimoireClassicRequirements: This class has no initiation-stage requirements. Existing skill points and scroll-learning rules apply.
LanguageData.TM_GrimoireNoLearningItems: No scroll-linked unlearned abilities are shown.
LanguageData.TM_GrimoireScrollUnspecified: A spell scroll is required; its item is not specified by this ability.
LanguageData.TM_ProgressionSharedLearning: Class directions share the existing skill-point pool.
LanguageData.TM_ProgressionBookUnavailable: This book cannot advance this initiation path yet.
LanguageData.TM_ProgressionOpenGrimoireDesc: View class initiation, spells and resources.
LanguageData.TM_ProgressionEnrollMageDesc: Begin the path of a mage and choose two basic spells in the grimoire. Class disciplines are learned through books. This replaces magical potential with the Mage vocation.
LanguageData.TM_ProgressionPriestHealingTrial: Healing trial: use your Advanced Heal spell to heal another friendly, living humanlike pawn. Before the cast, their injuries must total at least 20 severity; a single cast must remove at least 10.
LanguageData.TM_ProgressionNextBook: After completing the trial, read {0} to advance.
LanguageData.TM_ProgressionPriestVow: Priest's vow: incapable of violent work. Improved movement speed, immunity gain, medical speed, tending quality and surgery success; reduced pain shock threshold.
LanguageData.TM_ProgressionPriestPurificationTrial: Purification trial: use your own Purify spell to completely remove a pre-existing permanent injury or scar from another friendly, living humanlike pawn. Partial treatment, self-treatment and item casts do not complete the trial.
LanguageData.TM_ProgressionAscensionNeedsOffering: A Resurrection learning scroll must be reachable on the ground or already carried.
LanguageData.TM_ProgressionAscensionUnavailable: Ascension requirements or the magic circle are unavailable.
LanguageData.TM_ProgressionAscensionRequirements: Requires a Master priest, a large magic circle and a Resurrection learning scroll. The ritual takes one game hour. The scroll is offered only when the ritual completes; interruption preserves it.
LanguageData.TM_ProgressionNecromancerControlTrial: Control trial: maintain the same owned undead servant for one day. Time counts only while you and the servant are on the same map. Leaving the map or travelling in a caravan pauses progress; losing or replacing the servant resets it.
LanguageData.TM_ProgressionNecromancerDeathMarkTrial: Death Mark trial: defeat a hostile enemy while your own Death Mark is active on them. An ally may deliver the final blow. Allies and prisoners do not count.
LanguageData.TM_ProgressionNecromancerAscensionNeedsO: A Lich Form learning scroll must be reachable on the ground or already carried.
LanguageData.TM_ProgressionNecromancerAscensionRequir: Requires a Master necromancer, a large magic circle and a Lich Form learning scroll. The ritual takes one game hour. The scroll is consumed only at completion; interruption preserves it. Ascension unlocks the Lich Form transformation. Passions and timetable are retained.
LanguageData.TM_ProgressionFireboltTrial: Firebolt trial: deal 100 actual Firebolt damage to hostile creatures. Allies, prisoners and buildings do not count.
LanguageData.TM_ProgressionFireclawTrial: Deal damage to two different hostile creatures with a single Fireclaw. Allies, prisoners and buildings do not count.
LanguageData.TM_ProgressionFireAscensionNeedsOffering: A Firestorm learning scroll must be reachable on the ground or already carried.
LanguageData.TM_ProgressionFireAscensionRequirements: Requires a Master fire mage, a large magic circle and a Firestorm learning scroll. The ritual takes one game hour. The scroll is consumed only at completion; interruption preserves it. Ascension unlocks Firestorm.
LanguageData.TM_TomeQuestRequestDesc: Request an optional raid quest for your mastery tome. No attackers arrive until you accept. Victory awards the book; class trials are still required to study it. Traders remain an alternative.
LanguageData.TM_TomeQuestUnavailable: No suitable tome quest is available here. Try again at a home settlement; traders also sell mastery tomes.
LanguageData.TM_TomeQuestPeaceful: Combat quests are disabled by storyteller settings. Mastery tomes remain available from traders.
LanguageData.TM_TomeQuestCooldown: Wait one game day after your last tome quest before requesting another.
LanguageData.TM_TomeQuestBusy: A tome quest is already outstanding for this mage or settlement.
LanguageData.TM_TomeQuestDescription: {0} is threatened by {1} humanoid raiders (approximately {2} threat points). Accept to begin one game hour of preparation, then they walk in from the map edge. Repel this fixed group within two days: dead, downed, captured or retreated attackers count. Allies may do the fighting. Victory awards one {3}; select a colonist and use Claim mastery tome to choose a home map for delivery. Losing or abandoning the encounter map before victory fails the quest. Failure does not reset class progress. You may request another quest one day after failure or collecting the reward. The tome does not bypass class trials.
LanguageData.TM_ClassTomeClaimDesc: Choose a home settlement to receive the earned book. The same reward can only be claimed once.
LanguageData.TM_ClassTomePendingDesc: Your mastery tome is ready. Select any colonist and use Claim mastery tome to choose a home settlement for delivery. The reward remains available until claimed.

LanguageData.TM_ProgressionIceAttunementHint: Peaceful alternative: at a large magic circle, complete an attunement exercise for 100 silver and one game hour. It completes the current trial, not the book or stage.
